description: Deck 1 of the legal loadout spec 09 saves. SPEC §8 cards #1-#20, so the three 09-deckbuilder decks are pairwise disjoint (L4: a card id appears in at most one deck) and each holds exactly DECK_SIZE distinct non-Token ids (L2, L3). Every card is owned once by a launch-grant profile (R111), which is what makes L5 pass at exactly one copy across the loadout. No card is chosen for its behaviour: spec 09 never starts a game, it only saves and re-reads the loadout, so the only properties that matter are the six the validator checks.
